mostWorthwhile.text: Making dung beetles and connecting them to soil gave nutrient recycling a concrete, understandable role in the grassland.

leastWorthwhile.text: The hunting-ground and predator-and-prey steps felt a little repetitive: both advanced the same expected connection.

surprise.text: Dung beetles were a more specific result than the general nutrient-return pathway I expected.

arbitrary.text: Eyes plus air had no clear purpose before it produced tracking senses; I followed it because it was the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would probably continue: bringing recycling and predation together was satisfying, though the run of single available choices made the later decisions less engaging.
